mapper.select: SELECT instrument_id AS instrumentId, ticker AS symbol, name, tradable, currency FROM instruments WHERE ticker = #{ticker}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlists ( watchlist_id, account_id, watchlist_group_id, instrument_id, added_at ) VALUES ( #{watchlistId}, #{accountId}, #{watchlistGroupId}, #{instrumentId}, #{addedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT watchlist_group_id AS watchlistGroupId, name, created_at AS createdAt FROM watchlist_groups WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT watchlist_group_id AS watchlistGroupId, account_id AS accountId, name FROM watchlist_groups WHERE watchlist_group_id = #{watchlistGroupId}
SELECT watchlist_group_id FROM watchlist_groups WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name})
SELECT watchlist_group_id FROM watchlist_groups WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist_groups ( watchlist_group_id, account_id, name, created_at ) VALUES ( #{watchlistGroupId}, #{accountId}, #{name}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT w.watchlist_id AS watchlistId, w.account_id AS accountId, i.ticker AS symbol, i.name AS instrumentName FROM watchlists w INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = w.instrument_id WHERE w.watchlist_id = #{watchlistId}
